text:
Noah: just pushed sharded-kv-prefetch + latency-aware-batcher to canary-pool-B. preliminary: p95 down ~30% for chat-like traffic, p50 down ~25%, token-cost ~15% lower. short-turn UX looks noticeably snappier. :tada:

Noah: what changed at a high level:
- KV cache split into 16 shards to reduce lock contention
- background prefetch per shard with jittered backoff to warm KV quickly
- batching switched from fixed-window to latency-aware (target p95)

Noah: config we tested:
```
kv_cache.shards=16
kv_cache.prefetch=true
kv.prefetch_budget_pct=0.15
batcher.algo=latency_aware
batcher.target_p95_ms=120
batcher.max_batch=64
```

Lina: nice. can you paste the bench command and numbers?

Noah: bench command we used:
./perfbench --model rwin-small --qps 800 --seq 256 --concurrency 32 --profile sharded-prefetch

samples:
- baseline p95 240ms -> new p95 168ms (-30%)
- baseline p50 40ms -> new p50 30ms (-25%)
- token-cost 0.0105 -> 0.0089 (-15%)

Carlos: any regressions at extreme concurrency? last time sharding helped latency but increased mem churn.

Noah: at concurrency=256 we saw working-set +12% and CPU for prefetch workers +8%. mitigation: per-pool prefetch budget (kv.prefetch_budget_pct). with budget=0.05 memory and CPU stayed in limits and p95 still improved ~20% vs baseline.

Jade: added trace tags: kv_shard, prefetch_hit, batching_policy=latency_aware so we can slice by shard and prefetch success. dashboards updated under eng-runtime -> sharded-prefetch.

perf-bot: canary deploy 1823456500 completed -> sharded-prefetch enabled on 4 nodes (pool B). no increase in 5xx observed.

ops-bot: smoke test: 1200 requests over 10m, 99.9% responses < 500ms, no OOMs.

Lina: rollout plan? fast rollback knobs?

Noah: promote to prod-canary tomorrow 06:00 UTC if no regressions. rollback: set kv.prefetch_enabled=false and batcher.algo=windowed via feature flags and restart pool (automated playbook, ~7min). ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-12999

Carlos: add note to runtime tuning doc about kv.prefetch_budget_pct recommended ranges by concurrency tier. I'll review the playbook after doc update.

Noah: will add perf note + sample prometheus queries for shard hit rate and prefetch inflight. followup perf writeup coming later today.

Lina: great win, thanks team :clap:

Noah: thanks all!
